text: Williamson型の球面固体回転輸送：傾いた軸と極通過 Williamson-type spherical rotation: tilted axes and pole crossing Williamson型の球面固体回転輸送：傾いた軸と極通過 q_t+\mathbf v\cdot\nabla_{\mathbb S^2}q=0,\quad q(\mathbf r,t)=q_0(R_{\mathbf n}(-2\pi t/T)\mathbf r); \mathbf n=(-\sin\alpha,0,\cos\alpha),\quad q_0(r)=\tfrac12[1+\cos(\pi r/R)]\ (r<R),\quad q_0=0\ (r\ge R) 単位球上の規定スカラー剛体回転に限定します。W92原著の式は未読で、Nair著者資料の選択式から規約を照合。両格子で整合しない位相の11回再配置を用います。双線形補間は非保存なので質量変動を報告し、時間収束や非線形の全球浅水コアは主張しません。 Williamson-type spherical rotation: tilted axes and pole crossing q_t+\mathbf v\cdot\nabla_{\mathbb S^2}q=0,\quad q(\mathbf r,t)=q_0(R_{\mathbf n}(-2\pi t/T)\mathbf r); \mathbf n=(-\sin\alpha,0,\cos\alpha),\quad q_0(r)=\tfrac12[1+\cos(\pi r/R)]\ (r<R),\quad q_0=0\ (r\ge R) Only prescribed scalar solid-body rotation on a unit sphere. Original W92 equations remain unread; selected Nair author formulas cross-check conventions. Both grids use eleven noncommensurate remaps. Bilinear interpolation is nonconservative; report mass drift and do not claim temporal convergence or a nonlinear global SWE core. williamson-sphere-transport Williamson型の球面固体回転輸送：傾いた軸と極通過 Williamson-type spherical rotation: tilted axes and pole crossing 厳密解・参照解 参照解 reference solution 解析解 Analytic reference
